theorem moduleCup_godement_pairing (X : Scheme.{u}) (F G : X.Modules) :
    letI : MonoidalPreadditive X.Modules :=
      Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1
    ∃ (K L M : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
      (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶ K)
      (b : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G ⟶ L)
      (c : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj (F ⊗ G) ⟶ M),
      QuasiIso a ∧ QuasiIso b ∧ QuasiIso c ∧
      K.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ L.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ M.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (K.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (L.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (M.X n))) ∧
      ∃ t : HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L ⟶ M,
        ∀ (V : X.Opens)
          (x : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F).X 0, V))
          (y : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G).X 0, V)),
          (t.f 0).val.app (op V)
            ((HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K L 0 0 0 (by simp)).val.app (op V)
              (tmulSection ((a.f 0).val.app (op V) x) ((b.f 0).val.app (op V) y))) =
            (c.f 0).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)

title: Godement Alexander–Whitney module pairing
statement: For a scheme X and module sheaves F,G, there exist nonnegative integer-indexed cochain complexes K,L,M of module sheaves, with flasque terms and quasi-isomorphic augmentations from F[0], G[0], and (F tensor G)[0], and a cochain map Tot(K tensor L) → M whose degree-zero section pairing agrees with tensoring sections under the augmentations.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Section 20.31; Godement/flasque construction in the proof of Lemma 20.31.4 (Tag 0FKV)

proof.text: Obtain flasque cosimplicial resolutions and their pointwise multiplication from moduleCup_godement_cosimplicial_input. Their alternating coface complexes extended by zero are strictly nonnegative. Apply moduleCup_cosimplicial_aw to the multiplication. Evaluate its degree-zero morphism equality on the tensor of augmented sections and compose it with the supplied augmentation identity. Assemble the existential witnesses and the resolution properties.

proof_origin.place: Section 20.30; Alexander–Whitney formula from Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, §1.1.4, p. 16.
